column4: 順調だった、海の旅に……

column5: 「Tch... Even at sea, the Monster Realm is still the Monster Realm.」

column4: 「どんよりしてますね……
column5: 「It's so gloomy...

column5: Will this cause problems for sailing?」
「Who knows... Hm?」

column4: 「どうですか、風は……
column5: 「How's the wind...

column5: I'd like it a bit faster...」

column5: 「I completely agree...

column5: 「I'd like to save that as a last resort...

column5: We can't use it forever, right?」

column5: 「Y-yeah, that's true...

column5: We didn't have much Hilara ore...」

column5: We were just checking our progress...」

column4: 「……問題でもあるのか」

column5: 「Well... it's the sixth day now,

column5: 「We spent five days preparing.

column5: Last time it was twelve, before that eleven,

column5: and the tide had already receded.」

column4: 「……なんだと？
column5: 「...What?

column5: Wasn't it supposed to be about two weeks?」

column5: 「Yeah. Even earlier... thirty years ago it lasted eighteen days.

column4: まあ平均すりゃ、そんなもんってことになる」

column5: 「...That's a bit risky.」

column5: 「Yes... At this distance... to the destination,

column4: あと二日は必要でしょうか」
column5: we'll need at least two more days.」

column4: 「予定より、ちょっと遅れてるのよね……」
column5: 「We're a bit behind schedule...」

column4: 「まあ、前触れ無く足下が消滅する訳じゃない。

column5: It recedes gradually.

column5: 「That's why we're discussing shifting course closer to land,
